claim: With SWF you write a decider program instead of declarative JSON state machines, in the programming language of your choice or with the Flow framework. That gives complete control over orchestration logic but increases the complexity of developing applications.

evidence.quote: With SWF, instead of writing state machines in declarative JSON, you can write a decider program to separate activity steps from decision steps. This provides you complete control over your orchestration logic, but increases the complexity of developing applications.
You may write decider programs in the programming language of your choice, or you may use the Flow framework to use programming constructs that structure asynchronous interactions for you.
